name: 深绿之魔弓使
desc: 自己场上有植物族怪兽存在的场合，不能向这张卡攻击。每把自己场上1只植物族怪兽作为祭品，场上存在的1张魔法·陷阱卡破坏。
faq: If "Arcane Archer of the Forest" is your only monster on the field, and you turn it into a Plant-Type monster, your opponent cannot attack, and you can Tribute "Arcane Archer of the Forest" to activate his own effect.
